categories.readerRule: Each actual path must equal $.<fixed reader> or begin $.<fixed reader>.; emit only that fixed reader identifier. Unknown/root reader paths invalidate diagnostics rather than guessing a reader.

categories.zero: MATCH only from actual empty differences and original child gate success; no categories guessed from delta count.
categories.aggregation: Every actual difference contributes exactly once; sum of category counts must equal actual difference count; values/dynamic keys/dates/arbitrary exception messages never serialized.

protocol.sequence: Only reader record1 then applyRead record2; no duplicate/reordered/extra record. With native failure allow partial report as partial failure, never acceptance. Absent applyRead is NOT_OBSERVED, never PASS.
protocol.stickyFailure: Observer functions contain own errors; a missing/partial record or inconsistent sequence cannot be repaired by a later success. The enclosing capture validator rejects. No mutation of original process.exitCode solely to hide an observer failure.
protocol.schemaPolicy: Reject unknown keys/prototype surprises/nonplain objects, nonfinite/negative/unsafe counts, inconsistent totals, unknown kind/category/enum, duplicate JSON keys, trailing bytes or non-UTF8. Never echo rejected input. Each writer record is exactly canonical JSON.stringify(record) plus LF; byte-exact parse/reserialize comparison rejects duplicate keys, alternate encodings and noncanonical/trailing content without a new parser dependency.
protocol.census: Preserve unchanged complete original4 tests. On fail preserve whatever complete census actually exists or mark unavailable; never fabricate zeros.
